messages.text: Hello there, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel, I'm Emily an AI Assistant, and How can I assist you today?
Hello? Can you hear me?
Yes, I can hear you clearly. Hello! Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. What would you like to order today?
My name is Jitin, and I would like to order some, bagel with, like, garlic bagel and, grilled chicken and dark dark toasted and one coffee as well.

For the Garlic Bagel, you can choose from a variety of spreads or additional toppings. Would you like to hear the available options for spreads or any extra additions to your bagel?
Sorry. Pardon? Can you please repeat it again?

[2025-07-03T17:16:06.342Z] assistant: Of course! You'd like a Garlic Bagel with grilled chicken, and you'd like it toasted. 

Would you like to hear the available options for spreads or any extra additions to your bagel?
As in, what

Sure thing! For your Garlic Bagel, you can choose from a variety of spreads like plain cream cheese, scallion cream cheese, strawberry, or even something like jalapeño or honey almond. You can also add extras

Strawberry.

[2025-07-03T17:16:06.343Z] assistant: Great choice! Your Garlic Bagel will have strawberry spread and grilled chicken, and it'll be toasted. 

Is there anything else I can get for you, Jitin?

[2025-07-03T17:16:06.343Z] assistant: Alright, Jitin, I've got your order for a Garlic Bagel with strawberry spread, grilled chicken, and it'll be toasted. 

Let me just confirm your order one last time. Is there anything else I can get for you?
No. All good for now.
Got it, Jitin! Your order for a Garlic Bagel with strawberry spread and grilled chicken, toasted, is all set. Thank you for choosing Manhattan Bagel. Have a great day!
Okay. Thank you.
You're welcome! Enjoy your Garlic Bagel, Jitin. See you soon! Have a great day!
Yeah. Bye bye. Is it my my order is done?
Your order is all set, Jitin! We'll have it ready for you to pick up shortly. Say goodbye to me now, and have a wonderful day!
What is the order ID?
You'll receive your order ID shortly via confirmation message. If you need it right now, I can look it up for you. Would you like me to do that?
Yeah. Can you please tell me daughter?
Sure, I can help with that. Could you please provide me with the last four digits
